name: How long does it take to see results from holistic nutrition coaching?
description: Results vary, with subtle changes often appearing in weeks and significant improvements over several months, depending on consistency and individual goals.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from holistic nutrition coaching?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results varies greatly depending on individual goals, consistency, and starting point. Some clients may notice subtle changes in energy or digestion within a few weeks, while more significant body composition changes or chronic condition improvements can take several months. Commitment to implementing the recommended changes and regular check-ins with your coach are key factors. At Cave Training, we emphasize sustainable progress over quick fixes, aligning nutritional changes with long-term fitness and health objectives.
